candidates.title: SMS alert to the ops team with the result of the Toppan Day-End job and the CES / CES-encrypt upload jobs
candidates.user_story: As an OCMS operations officer, I want the system to send an SMS with the success count of the nightly Toppan Day-End job and the CES upload jobs, so that I know the same night whether the batch jobs finished without opening the logs.
acceptance: After the Toppan Day-End job finishes, an SMS 'Job Status: Day End main - X/6 Success, oths - Y/3 Success' is sent to every number in cron.sms.alert.recipients
After the CES upload job (and the CES encrypted-upload callback), an SMS 'Job Status: CES - X/N Success' is sent to the same recipients
The alert is controlled only by cron.sms.alert.enabled; it still sends when the business SMS switch sms.enable is false
A job that did not run or failed counts as not-success in the numerator (denominators are fixed in code)
The environment tag is added to the message text so UAT and PROD alerts can be told apart

evidence.what: Day-End scheduler calls sendDayEndSms(taskResults) after the sub-jobs
Builds the 'Job Status: Day End main ... oths ...' text and calls jobSmsAlertHelper.sendAlert
CES upload job sends 'Job Status: CES - x/y Success' through the same helper
CES encrypted-upload callback also sends the CES status SMS
sendAlert: checks cron.sms.alert.enabled and recipients, loops over recipients
sendSmsForAlert bypasses the sms.enable kill switch (comment says ops alerts must still arrive)
cron.sms.alert.enabled=true and a recipient list are set in PROD (numbers not repeated here)
cron.toppanupload.enabled=true, so the Day-End scheduler runs in PROD config

candidates.works_basis: Code path is complete and the alert flag is true in PROD properties; sms.enable=false (application-prod.properties:87) does not block it because sendSmsForAlert bypasses it. Two tickets say it was deployed to PROD (OCMS-SR-2026-040 and 041, Closed / Prod deployed). Whether the APIM SMS gateway really delivers and whether the numbers are still valid cannot be verified from the repo. No unit test was looked for.
candidates.ura_requested: ticket: OCMS-SR-2026-041 (Toppan Day-End SMS alert) and OCMS-SR-2026-040 (CES upload SMS alert). No flow deck exists in repo.
candidates.points_basis: Estimate only. Similar in size to OCMS9.8 (retry sending, 3 points): one helper, three call sites, one config toggle, no screen. MGG and URA decide the final number.
demo_steps: In UAT set cron.sms.alert.enabled=true with a test number in cron.sms.alert.recipients
Trigger the Toppan Day-End job from the cron screen (or wait for 00:15) and check the SMS 'Job Status: Day End main - X/6 Success, oths - Y/3 Success'
Trigger the CES upload job and check the 'Job Status: CES - x/y Success' SMS
risks: Not a story; URA may say it is an operational nicety and part of the cron stories (OCMS8.11 daily letter reports, OCMS27.22 trace also mentions the alert helper).
Both tickets are maintenance tickets (SR), so URA may treat the work as already covered by the maintenance contract, not as new scope.
OCMS-SR-2026-150 (check count file for CES alert) is still Ready to DEV / In SIT, so the CES alert may change.
Recipient phone numbers sit in a properties file in the repo; do not attach that file to the claim.

candidates.title: Postal registration number from Toppan registered-mail return files (RD2 / DN2), saved on the notice and shown in the staff portal
candidates.related_note: OCMS8.11 (Requirement given, not paid) asks for daily summary reports on letters sent to the vendor. OCMS11.12 / OCMS11.32 / OCMS12.x only cover sending the 2nd letter to the vendor. None of them mention reading the vendor's return file for the postal registration number of the registered-mail letter, storing it, or showing it on the notice. This candidate is that return-file processing and the screen field only.
candidates.user_story: As a Notice Processing Officer, I want the OCMS to read the registered-mail return files that Toppan sends back for 2nd reminders and Driver Notices and record the postal registration number against the notice, so that I can see the Postal Reg. Number on the notice screen and trace the registered letter.
acceptance: The Toppan Download cron accepts files named DPT-URA-RD2-D2-* and DPT-URA-DN2-D2-* and parses notice number plus postal registration number
For an RD2 file the number is written to ocms_request_driver_particulars.postal_regn_no; for a DN2 file to ocms_driver_notice.postal_regn_no (update only, the tracking row must already exist)
An existing number is not overwritten with a blank value
The staff portal notice detail (RDP and DN section) shows the field 'Postal Reg. Number'
Notices in the file that are not in VON are reported as errors, not silently skipped

evidence.what: Routes DPT-URA-RD2-D2-* and DPT-URA-DN2-D2-* files to the registered-mail parser
isValidResponseFile lists the RD2 / DN2 return files as processed files
Reads postalRegistrationNumbers from the parse result and passes them to processStageTransitions
Chooses tracking table: RD2 -> ocms_request_driver_particulars, DN2 -> ocms_driver_notice
Comment describing the JOIN UPDATE that writes postal_regn_no and keeps the old value when the new one is null
API returns postalRegnNo of the driver notice
API returns postalRegnNo of the request-driver record
Notice detail shows the postalRegnNo field for RDP and for DN
Label text 'Postal Reg. Number'
Toppan Download cron 01:30 enabled=true in PROD config

candidates.works_basis: Code chain is complete from file name to DB column to screen, and the download cron is enabled in PROD config. But PROD sets sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan (application-prod.properties:86), so letters may not be uploaded to Toppan from this tier and therefore no return file would come back; whether real RD2 / DN2 return files have ever been processed in PROD cannot be verified from the repo. The note in ToppanStageTransitionService says this service does NOT move stages; stage moves are done elsewhere in the same download job and are not part of this claim.
candidates.ura_requested: no (no flow deck exists in repo; no maintenance ticket found for it)
candidates.points_basis: Estimate only. Comparable to OCMS8.10 (daily summary reports from ICA/DOS data, 5 points): a file parser, a bulk update into two tables, two API fields and two screen fields. MGG and URA decide the final number.
demo_steps: In UAT put a DPT-URA-DN2-D2-<timestamp> test file with one existing DN2 notice on the Toppan download SFTP folder
Run the Toppan Download cron from the cron screen
Open the notice in the staff portal, RDP and DN section, and check 'Postal Reg. Number' is filled
risks: OCMS8.11 and the Toppan letter stories sit in the same job; URA may say the return-file handling is part of 'send letters to vendor'.
Toppan upload is blocked in PROD config (application-prod.properties:86), so real use is unproven.
File format of the return file is only known from code, not from an interface spec in the repo.
Part of the same job (ACK-based stage moves, 'List of DNs processed' report) is deliberately NOT claimed here to avoid double claim.

candidates.title: Administration fee added to the amount payable at the final reminder stage (RR3 / DR3) and cleared when the notice is redirected to a new party
candidates.related_note: OCMS11.42 and OCMS12.31 (Demo paid) cover sending the 3rd letter reminder to the hirer / driver via the vendor. Neither text mentions an administration fee or a change of amount payable at that stage. The only 'admin fee' wording in stories is in OCMS1.3-1.10 (all marked User Story Removed, pre-notice charges) and OCMS9.1. This candidate is the fee rule at RR3/DR3 and its reset on furnish redirect.
candidates.user_story: As a Notice Processing Officer, I want the OCMS to add the configured administration fee to the amount payable when a notice reaches the final reminder stage (RR3 for owner/hirer, DR3 for driver) and to remove it when the notice is redirected to a new owner/hirer/driver, so that the amount the offender sees and pays is correct for the stage.
acceptance: When the Toppan stage update moves a notice to RR3 or DR3, administration_fee is set from ocms_parameter code ADM for that stage and amount_payable = composition_amount + administration_fee
For any other stage, administration_fee is written as 0 and amount_payable stays at composition_amount
If the ADM parameter is missing or not a number, the fee is not written and a warning is logged
When a furnish is approved (cron auto-approve, staff furnish, or manual review) and the notice goes back to DN1 / RD1, administration_fee is set to 0 and amount_payable is reset to composition_amount

evidence.what: Reads parameter ADM for the stage (RR3 / DR3 only)
RR3/DR3: amount_payable = composition + fee; other stages: fee = 0 (fix for OCMS-DF-2026-170)
Cron furnish approval zeroes the fee on redirect
Staff furnish zeroes the fee (also :415)
Manual review approval zeroes the fee

candidates.works_basis: The logic is in code and was patched after a PROD report (OCMS-DF-2026-170, Closed / Prod deployed), so it ran in PROD at least once. The value of ADM in the database cannot be verified from the repo (ticket text says $15). The stage update runs inside the Toppan upload flow, which is limited in PROD config by sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan (application-prod.properties:86); how far the stage update still runs with that setting depends on the delivery-gate bypass and cannot be confirmed here.
candidates.ura_requested: ticket: OCMS-DF-2026-170 (URA staff describe the $15 fee at RR3/DR3 as expected behaviour and report wrong application) and OCMS-DF-2026-122 (foreign-vehicle $15 fee). No flow deck exists in repo.
candidates.points_basis: Estimate only. Similar to OCMS8.10 (5 points) in effort: parameter lookup, stage-update arithmetic and three furnish paths. MGG and URA decide the final number.
demo_steps: In UAT make sure ocms_parameter has ADM rows for RR3 and DR3
Run the Toppan Day-End job on a notice that is one stage before RR3 and check administration_fee and amount_payable on the notice detail
Furnish a new hirer for that notice and check the fee is back to 0 and amount_payable equals composition_amount
risks: Brief and project history treat 'admin fee' as a leftover of removed stories (OCMS1.x). URA may see this as the same thing; the difference is that this is a final-reminder-stage fee, not the pre-notice fee. This needs a business decision before billing.
The two tickets are defect fixes (DF) on this logic; URA may argue the fee itself was already in an earlier paid scope.
The fee amount lives in the database, not in the repo; cannot verify the real value.
Foreign-vehicle admin fee job (day-end job 5 'Admin Fee') is NOT included: it belongs to the foreign vehicle area where OCMS14.30-14.32 were removed.

candidates.title: Daily 'Listed Vehicle' file of unpaid foreign-vehicle notices (PS-FOR) sent to REPCCS
candidates.related_note: Sits next to OCMS10.1 (ANS vehicle list), OCMS2.1 (NOPO archival list) and OCMS2.2 (offence rule list), which are the other files made by the same job. No story text mentions a list of foreign vehicles for REPCCS. Already registered as orphan 'REPCCS Listed Vehicle (foreign vehicle FOR) daily file to REPCCS' in meta.json.
candidates.user_story: As a Notice Processing Officer, I want the OCMS to send REPCCS a daily list of foreign vehicles that still have unpaid notices under PS-FOR past the configured period, so that REPCCS can show the 'Outstanding notices. Call URA ...' message to those vehicles.
acceptance: The REPCCS Generate File job runs the Listed Vehicle service as its 3rd step
The query selects distinct vehicle_no from VON where suspension_type = PS, epr_reason_of_suspension = FOR, nothing paid, and notice date is older than ocms_parameter FOR / PERIOD days
A fixed-width file (header H, detail D with licence plate and message, trailer T with record count) is built
The file is saved to Azure blob and sent for PGP encryption and SFTP upload through the comcrypt callback
When no vehicle qualifies the service ends with 0 records and no file is sent

evidence.what: Job calls executeRepccsListedVehicle() as service 3 of 4
Queries vehicles, builds the file, uploads to blob, then asks comcrypt for encryption and SFTP upload
findRepccsForeignVehicleNotices: PS-FOR, unpaid, older than FOR/PERIOD days
CASREP file layout: header, detail, trailer, 150 characters per record
Manual trigger POST /crontest/repccs/execute-scheduled-job
cron.repupload.enabled=false in PROD (UAT has it true at cron-schedules-uat.properties:196)

candidates.works_basis: Code path is complete and the cron is enabled in UAT. In PROD config the whole REPCCS upload cron is off (cron-schedules-prod.properties:194), so it runs only if someone triggers it by hand; real PROD server values cannot be verified. Whether REPCCS actually consumes the file cannot be verified from the repo.
candidates.ura_requested: no (no flow deck exists in repo; no maintenance ticket found for it)
candidates.points_basis: Estimate only. Same size as OCMS2.2 (offence rule list to REPCCS, 3 points) which uses the same pattern: one query, one file generator, same upload path. MGG and URA decide the final number.
demo_steps: In UAT make sure one PS-FOR unpaid notice is older than the FOR / PERIOD parameter
Check the generated Listed Vehicle file in blob and the encrypted file on the REPCCS SFTP folder
risks: Foreign-vehicle handling is the area where OCMS14.30-14.32 were removed; URA may call this a leftover of that scope.
REPCCS upload cron is disabled in PROD config; URA can say it is not in use.
URA never asked for it as far as the repo shows (no ticket, no flow deck).
The other three files of the same job overlap with OCMS2.1, OCMS2.2 and OCMS10.1 and must not be claimed again.

notes: Most of the 46 seeds are sub-rules of flows that already have a story (eNotification, Toppan letters, special vehicles, DataHive checks). Seeds are heavily duplicated: TS-HST after eNotification appears 6 times, Toppan registered-mail return file 4 times, MID / DIP letter exceptions 5 times. All OCMS1.x stories are 'User Story Removed', so seed notes that point at OCMS1.x as the nearest story do not give coverage either way; for REPCCS notice intake the live story is OCMS3.1. Key PROD flags (ocmsadminprivateapi): cron.repupload.enabled=false, cron.notification.enabled=false, cron.mhadownload.uenfin.enabled=false, sms.enable=false, email.enableSmtp=false, sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan. Real server values cannot be verified from the repo. Phone numbers and e-mail recipients in application-prod.properties must not be copied into the report. HST (manual HST, monthly HST report, TS-HST looping) was seen in orphans but belongs to another cluster, so it is not claimed here. Stale folder ocmsadminprivateapi/cronservice was not used for any citation.
